@@ ARMOR • Light/Medium/Heavy
@description:
 Heavy Skill Each Armor Type has a Moving Maneuver Penalty (MMP)
 Descriptions associated with it for untrained individuals (refer to Armor
 T-3.3). This penalty modifies Moving Maneuver rolls. The ferent armor types
 are divided into five groups based upon composition of the armor: types 1-4
 = No armor; types 5-8 Leather; types 9-12 = Rigid Leather; types 13-16 =
 Chain; types 17-20 = Plate. There are no Moving Maneuver Penalties
 associated with No Armor, and therefore there is no need to skill ranks
 towards it. The Soft and Rigid Leather skills are both found in the Armor
 Skill Category; Chain is found in the Medium Armor Category; Plate is found
 in the Heavy Armor Skill Category. Every encumbering armor has a minimum
 maneuver associated with it. The skill bonus for maneuvering for a group
 armor types reduces the maximum penalty for maneuvering the minimum
 maneuver penalty is reached. This limit represents the fact that the weight
 and constriction of the armor will hinder the character to some extent.
 These minimums may for certain superior or magical armor. Example: Dral has
 20 category and skill ranks in Maneuvering in Plate Armor. He may wear
 breastplate greaves (AT 18) with a MMP of only 30 = 110 - ((10 + (10 x 3)).
 If he wears just the breastplate (AT 17), MMP is 15 even though 90 - ((10 x
 5)+ (10 x 3)) = 10; since 15 is the minimum maneuver penalty associated
 with wearing a breastplate. Notes on the Advantages of Armor Types: Armor
 types designed to reflect the protective capability on one’s covering.
 Heavier coverings (e.g., ATs 15, 16, 19, 20, etc.) are usually more
 cumbersome than light armor or mere clothing. It is to make contact with
 combatants in heavy armor in combat, it resists penetration better than the
 less cumbersome armor Therefore, “critical strikes” achieved against the
 more cumbersome armor types will be less frequent and lower in severity.
 However attacks resulting in just concussion hits will be frequent (i.e.,
 the hindrance due to these coverings make target easier to strike but
 harder to seriously damage). Less cumbersome armor types have the advantage
 of ing the wearer with mobility. Fewer swings will make because the agile
 defender will completely avoid the However, when a swing does make contact,
 the result is more severe than it would be against the more cumbersome
 types: frequent and severe criticals along with more concussion hits are
 the rule. Animals often attack the upper body. In addition, their etrating
 power is usually limited. This is reflected in the Law animal attack
 tables. Animals and monsters can be devastating against the lighter armor
 types where the wearer’s mobility is outweighed by the creature’s superior
 maneuverability. However, against higher armor types, most beast attacks
 relatively ineffective. Spell attacks are also affected by armor. Metal
 armor particularly effective when a character is resisting spells, often
 lessens the wearer’s mobility. Therefore, he may be to hit with most
 Elemental spells but harder to severely damage. Rolemaster Standard
 Lightning, and other forms of electrical attacks, are more Rules tive
 against metal clad foes. Fire is more effective against 142 mable armor
 types; primarily the organic armor types leather and cloth). In addition,
 each armor type has a Quickness penalty associTable ated with it. This
 penalty is applied against the bonus one’s difQuickness stat bonus gives to
 the Defensive Bonus. Note that the penalty cannot bring one’s Quickness
 stat bonus below zero = Soft for the purposes of one’s DB; any result below
